symptom: View entities, external entities and entities imported with `create external entities from` were placed on one row (X = 100 + n*150, Y = 100), 150px apart: a 40-entity module was a 6,000px line and the entity boxes touched. CREATE ENTITY had already moved to a wrapping grid.
cause: dmlayout.GridSlot replaced the single-row formula in the CREATE ENTITY handler only; three other creation paths kept a private copy of the old formula, and the contract import counted only the entities it had created itself (created+updated), ignoring the entities the module already held.
fix: All three call dmlayout.GridSlot(n) with n = entities already in the domain model; the contract import uses the count read before its loop plus the entities created so far (a created entity is not in that domain model value).
insight: **When a default moves into a shared helper, grep for the old formula's literal constants, not the old function**: `grep -rn '\* *150' mdl/executor --include=*.go` finds the stragglers in seconds, while a search for the call site of the helper never will. The mock backend appends to dm.Entities on CreateEntity but the real one does not mutate the value it handed out, so a count taken inside the loop is right in the test and wrong in production; read it once before the loop.
